as_told.title: Wernher von Braun warned Carol Rosin of a planned alien invasion

plain: The rocket engineer Wernher von Braun is said to have warned, near the end of his life in 1977, that powerful people planned to fake an alien threat to unite the world. Steven Greer, a campaigner for UFO disclosure, says von Braun told this on his deathbed to his friend Carol Rosin, and in one telling calls it a false flag and dates von Braun's death to 1974. Michels also mentions von Braun talking about this at the end of his life, though he garbles the name of the woman as Carolyn Ross. If true, it would mean a future alien invasion could be staged on purpose.
